warning: Draft research claims only. None is approved for production or assigned to a final day.

claims.claim: Structured web-based mental-health-literacy interventions can improve some knowledge and related literacy outcomes but the evidence does not establish a reliable transition to actual help-seeking across populations.
claims.evidence_type: systematic reviews
claims.population: Adults across heterogeneous web and help-seeking intervention studies
claims.cultural_context: Evidence is predominantly from high-income and non-Arab settings
claims.limitations: Interventions outcomes and populations varied and actual help-seeking was less consistent than knowledge attitudes or intentions.
claims.counterevidence: School-based review evidence did not show strong improvement in help-seeking outcomes and some adult reviews report unclear behavior transfer.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: قد تساعد البرامج المنظمة في زيادة بعض جوانب المعرفة النفسية؛ لكن زيادة المعرفة لا تعني تلقائيًا أن الشخص سيطلب مساعدة فعلية.

claims.claim: Help-seeking interventions have shown improvements in some attitudes intentions and formal help-seeking outcomes with effects that differ by intervention population outcome and follow-up.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review meta-analysis and updated systematic review
claims.population: Adults and mixed populations in controlled trials across multiple countries
claims.cultural_context: Few low- and middle-income country studies in the earlier synthesis and heterogeneous later studies
claims.date_range: Trials covered through the post-2016 review window
claims.limitations: Formal informal and self-help outcomes cannot be combined and intention is not equivalent to behavior.
claims.counterevidence: Effects were not uniform for general-public or youth settings and informal help seeking did not consistently improve.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: بعض التدخلات قد تحسن الموقف أو النية أو خطوة طلب المساعدة؛ لكن النتيجة تختلف حسب الناس والسياق ونوع الدعم ولا يجوز مساواة النية بالسلوك.

claims.claim: Current randomized school evidence does not provide strong support that school mental-health-literacy interventions improve help-seeking outcomes.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review of randomized controlled trials
claims.population: Young people across 11 studies and 66 secondary schools
claims.cultural_context: School settings and countries represented in the review; direct Egyptian transfer not established
claims.limitations: Few studies inconsistent outcome measures and no cost-effectiveness evidence.
claims.counterevidence: Other broader reviews find improvements for some help-seeking outcomes in other populations or intervention combinations.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: التثقيف المدرسي وحده لم يُظهر حتى الآن دليلًا قويًا ومتسقًا على زيادة طلب المساعدة؛ لذلك يجب اختبار السلوك الفعلي لا المعرفة فقط.

claims.claim: Mental-health-literacy measurement is fragmented across knowledge stigma and help-seeking constructs and only a subset of identified measures had validation evidence in the reviewed literature.
claims.evidence_type: scoping review
claims.population: Quantitative studies of mental-health-literacy measures
claims.cultural_context: English-language evidence with no demonstrated Egyptian validation in this source
claims.date_range: Literature indexed up to the 2015 review
claims.limitations: The review excluded non-English and grey literature and is now old enough to require an updated measurement search.
claims.counterevidence: Newer validated tools may exist and must be identified in an updated Arabic and international review.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: لا توجد درجة واحدة بسيطة تقيس «الثقافة النفسية» كلها؛ فالمعرفة والوصمة وطلب المساعدة جوانب مختلفة وأدواتها تحتاج تحققًا للغة والسكان.

claims.claim: Mental-health help seeking in the Eastern Mediterranean Region is shaped by interacting cultural acceptability stigma privacy engagement and health-system factors rather than knowledge alone.
claims.evidence_type: WHO regional situation analysis
claims.population: Populations across the Eastern Mediterranean Region
claims.cultural_context: Regional synthesis with selected Egyptian evidence rather than an Egypt-only population study
claims.date_range: Evidence synthesized in a 2026 regional report
claims.limitations: The source cannot quantify an Egyptian barrier or establish that all groups experience the same factors.
claims.counterevidence: Local service trust resources family support and help pathways may differ substantially within and between countries.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: طلب المساعدة لا يعتمد على المعرفة وحدها؛ فقد تتداخل الوصمة والخصوصية والثقة والتكلفة وتوافر الخدمة بطريقة تختلف من شخص ومكان لآخر.

claims.claim: A listed support resource must be treated as time-sensitive operational information and must not be published solely because it appears in an official directory.
claims.evidence_type: official resource directory plus operational safety rule
claims.population: People seeking support in Egypt
claims.cultural_context: Egyptian telephone and service environment
claims.date_range: Directory checked 2026-08-13 with underlying entry date not established
claims.limitations: The directory page does not itself prove that every number and operating time is currently active.
claims.counterevidence: Direct confirmation from each service owner may validate or invalidate individual entries.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: لا نعرض رقم مساعدة قبل التأكد حديثًا من الجهة المالكة والغرض وساعات العمل؛ وجوده في صفحة رسمية قديمة لا يكفي وحده.

claims.claim: Emotion-regulation strategies are associated with mental-health indicators, but relationships vary by context and do not establish one universally best strategy.
claims.evidence_type: associational meta-analysis
claims.population: Participants across 48 studies and multiple cultural settings
claims.cultural_context: Culture moderated some findings involving expressive suppression
claims.limitations: Associations do not prove that assigning a strategy causes improvement, and broad cultural categories do not establish Egyptian applicability.
claims.counterevidence: A strategy associated with poorer outcomes in one context may be neutral or socially functional in another.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: لا توجد طريقة واحدة تصلح لتنظيم المشاعر في كل موقف ولكل شخص؛ جرّب بمرونة ولاحظ ما يناسب الموقف والقيم والبيئة الاجتماعية.

claims.claim: Self-compassion interventions show small-to-medium immediate improvements in several distress outcomes, but risk of bias and weaker active-control and follow-up evidence require caution.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials
claims.population: Participants in 56 randomized controlled trials
claims.cultural_context: Multi-country evidence without demonstrated Egyptian adaptation
claims.limitations: Intervention evidence cannot be assigned to a single micro-exercise; active-control and follow-up results were less convincing.
claims.counterevidence: Some apparent improvement may reflect attention, expectancy, comparison choice, or study bias.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: قد يفيد بعض الناس الرد على التعثر بلغة أقل قسوة، لكن هذا تمرين تجريبي وليس علاجًا ولا ضمانًا لتغيّر الضيق.

claims.claim: Habit automaticity does not emerge on one universal timetable; formation time varies substantially by person, behavior, and context.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.population: Participants in 20 experimental health-behavior studies
claims.cultural_context: Selected health behaviors; Egyptian everyday transfer is untested
claims.limitations: Most studies had high risk of bias and used self-reported automaticity.
claims.counterevidence: Some changes can be faster, but that does not support a universal fixed-day promise.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: لا يوجد عدد ثابت من الأيام يصنع عادة عند الجميع؛ راقب سهولة السلوك وعدّل البيئة والخطوة بدل اعتبار البطء فشلًا.

claims.claim: Self-monitoring is not universally beneficial and can have null or detrimental effects, so tracking should be optional, bounded, and easy to stop.
claims.evidence_type: domain-specific descriptive systematic review
claims.population: People in substance-use self-monitoring studies
claims.cultural_context: Clinical and research contexts not specific to Egypt or ordinary habits
claims.limitations: Reported percentages must not be generalized from substance use to all tracking.
claims.counterevidence: Some methods and populations benefited, so a blanket harm claim would also be unsupported.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: التتبع أداة اختيارية لا اختبار نجاح؛ إذا زاد الضغط أو الانشغال أو لم يفدك، قلّله أو أوقفه واختر ملاحظة أخف.

claims.claim: Sleep-hygiene advice is inconsistently defined and should not be represented as adequate treatment for clinically significant insomnia.
claims.evidence_type: bibliographic review and systematic review with meta-analysis
claims.population: Adults across sleep-hygiene and insomnia studies
claims.cultural_context: Multi-country evidence without Egyptian validation
claims.limitations: Specific advice needs evidence and adaptation for shift work, caregiving, illness, housing, and other constraints.
claims.counterevidence: Education may support general sleep health but was less effective than CBT-I in insomnia comparisons.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: يمكن تجربة تعديل بسيط يناسب ظروف نومك، لكن الأرق المستمر أو المؤثر في حياتك لا يُختزل في نصائح عامة ويستحق تقييمًا مهنيًا مناسبًا.

claims.claim: Objective social contact and perceived quality of connection are distinct outcomes and can respond to different strategies.
claims.evidence_type: global public-health report and systematic review with meta-analysis
claims.population: Adults in controlled trials plus global populations
claims.cultural_context: Meanings of closeness, privacy, family duty, and community vary culturally
claims.limitations: The meta-analysis had an older mean sample age and heterogeneous interventions.
claims.counterevidence: More contacts do not necessarily improve felt safety, belonging, or relationship quality.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: زيادة عدد العلاقات ليست الهدف الوحيد؛ قد تكون الخطوة الأنسب تقوية علاقة آمنة أو طلب دعم محدد أو الوصول لمساحة اجتماعية ملائمة لك.

claims.claim: Psychological treatments targeting procrastination show a small heterogeneous pooled effect, so persistent procrastination should not be reduced to laziness or promised a quick universal fix.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.population: Participants in 12 psychological-treatment studies
claims.cultural_context: Small multi-country evidence base not validated for Egyptian users
claims.limitations: Only 12 studies were included and the CBT subgroup contained three studies.
claims.counterevidence: Some people benefit from structured approaches, but no universal productivity technique is established.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: التسويف ليس دليلًا تلقائيًا على الكسل؛ جرّب تصغير البداية وفحص العائق، وإذا استمر بصورة مؤثرة ففكّر في دعم يناسب السبب والظروف.

claims.claim: Physical-activity guidance must be adapted to ability, health status, and circumstances without shame-based or rigid prescriptions.
claims.evidence_type: WHO evidence-informed public-health guideline
claims.population: General and specified populations across the life course
claims.cultural_context: Global guidance requiring local feasibility and accessibility adaptation
claims.limitations: Motazen cannot assess contraindications, disability needs, pregnancy, chronic disease, pain, or individual exercise risk.
claims.counterevidence: A standardized dose or activity can be inaccessible or unsafe for some users.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: اختر حركة ممكنة وآمنة تناسب قدرتك وظروفك ولو كانت صغيرة، واستشر مختصًا عند وجود حالة صحية أو ألم أو قلق بشأن الأمان.

claims.claim: Structured teacher-led mindfulness programs can improve some average outcomes compared with no intervention, but effects vary and superiority to specific active alternatives is not established.
claims.evidence_type: preregistered systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.population: 11605 nonclinical adults across 136 trials
claims.cultural_context: Twenty-nine countries but no established Egyptian adaptation for Motazen
claims.limitations: The evidence concerns multi-session expert-defined programs, many trials had high risk of bias, and prediction intervals included no effect.
claims.counterevidence: Specific active alternatives may work similarly, and effects do not generalize to every setting.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: تمارين الانتباه ليست مناسبة للجميع ولا يلزم إجبار نفسك عليها؛ جرّبها باختصار واختر بديلًا حركيًا أو حسيًا إذا زادت انزعاجك.

claims.claim: Adult resilience-intervention evidence is too heterogeneous and methodologically limited to support a single universal resilience formula.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review
claims.population: Adults in 38 controlled intervention reports
claims.cultural_context: Evidence concentrated in studied settings and definitions varied
claims.limitations: Fair quality, low power, and inconsistent theories and measures prevent confident comparison.
claims.counterevidence: Reported significant results coexist with substantial methodological limitations and cannot support guaranteed outcomes.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: المرونة ليست مطالبة بتحمّل الضرر ولا صفة ثابتة؛ التعافي يتأثر بمواردك ودعمك والظروف المحيطة، وليس بالإرادة وحدها.

claims.claim: Clinical treatments can reduce intolerance of uncertainty in adults with generalized anxiety disorder, but this does not make a general uncertainty exercise a treatment.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical treatment
claims.population: 1199 adults with generalized anxiety disorder
claims.cultural_context: Clinical samples across studied settings; Egyptian general-population transfer unknown
claims.limitations: Directly targeted CBT superiority was not maintained at follow-up, and Motazen does not diagnose or treat GAD.
claims.counterevidence: Ordinary uncertainty may be realistic and linked to unstable conditions rather than an individual deficit.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: قد يساعد فصل ما تعرفه عما لا تعرفه وما يمكنك فعله الآن، لكن القلق المستمر أو المعطل يحتاج دعمًا مناسبًا ولا يُختزل في تمرين.

claims.claim: Problem-solving therapy evidence cannot be simplified into a claim that a standalone problem-solving worksheet treats depression or anxiety.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.population: Adults with depression in primary-care trials
claims.cultural_context: Clinical primary-care evidence without Egyptian product validation
claims.limitations: The face-to-face problem-solving therapy estimate crossed no effect and delivery modes differed.
claims.counterevidence: Other focused syntheses report benefit in selected clinical populations, reinforcing that context and delivery matter.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: تقسيم المشكلة قد يساعدك على رؤية خطوة تالية، لكنه لا يجعل كل مشكلة قابلة للحل الفردي ولا يحل محل الدعم المهني عند الحاجة.

claims.claim: Debiasing interventions often show partial task-specific success, but evidence does not establish durable transfer to every consequential decision.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review
claims.population: Lay people and health professionals across 87 studies
claims.cultural_context: Samples were often students and were not specific to Egypt
claims.limitations: Methods, biases, outcomes, and quality varied; sample-size and measurement reporting were frequent weaknesses.
claims.counterevidence: Some interventions were not successful, and sometimes the assumed bias was not present.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: معرفة اسم الانحياز لا تمنع الخطأ تلقائيًا؛ استخدم وقفة قصيرة واسأل عن الدليل والبدائل وما الذي قد يغيّر رأيك.

claims.claim: Among surveyed Egyptian undergraduates, mental-health-literacy dimensions related unevenly to help-seeking, and greater knowledge cannot be assumed to produce professional service use.
claims.evidence_type: direct Egyptian cross-sectional multi-centre studies
claims.population: Egyptian university students
claims.cultural_context: Ten-university and multi-centre Egyptian student samples
claims.limitations: Convenience and online sampling, self-report, cross-sectional designs, and student-only populations limit inference.
claims.counterevidence: Literacy factors were not uniformly associated with professional help-seeking, and personal, religious, and informal routes remained relevant.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: المعرفة خطوة مهمة لكنها لا تزيل وحدها التكلفة أو الوصمة أو مخاوف الخصوصية؛ اختر طريق مساعدة واقعيًا وآمنًا يناسب ظروفك.

claims.claim: Help-seeking barriers in Egyptian and wider Arab evidence are multi-level and include self-reliance preferences, stigma, privacy, trust, literacy, logistics, and service access.
claims.evidence_type: Egyptian cross-sectional study, Arab systematic review, and WHO regional synthesis
claims.population: Egyptian undergraduates and heterogeneous Arab adult populations
claims.cultural_context: Direct Egyptian student evidence nested within broader Arab and EMRO evidence
claims.limitations: Most regional evidence concerns attitudes and intentions, barriers differ within Egypt, and no single route is suitable for everyone.
claims.counterevidence: Family and religious support can facilitate care for some people as well as delay formal care for others; they must not be stereotyped as inherently helpful or harmful.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: العائق قد يكون داخليًا أو اجتماعيًا أو عمليًا؛ سمِّ العائق الفعلي ثم ابحث عن خطوة تقلله بدل لوم نفسك على التأخر.

claims.claim: Egyptian psychiatrist support for electronic mental health suggests implementation interest, not proof that a digital product is effective, equitable, safe, or a replacement for care.
claims.evidence_type: direct Egyptian provider survey
claims.population: 188 responding Egyptian psychiatrists
claims.cultural_context: Egyptian mental-health system and 2020 digital environment
claims.limitations: Low response, provider-only sample, unvalidated self-report instrument, and changing technology conditions.
claims.counterevidence: Respondents also raised technology and rapport concerns, and users without reliable internet were not represented.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: المحتوى الرقمي قد يسهّل الوصول للمعلومة، لكنه لا يضمن الخصوصية أو الجودة ولا يحل محل المختص أو خدمة الطوارئ.

claims.claim: Relationship-education programs show modest average communication effects, which do not establish that one script works across relationships or power conditions.
claims.evidence_type: meta-analysis and systematic review
claims.population: Couples plus healthcare professionals and students
claims.cultural_context: Non-Egyptian program evidence across specialized settings
claims.limitations: Effects vary by measure, follow-up, distress, setting, and hierarchy; sustained real-world behavior evidence is limited.
claims.counterevidence: A direct or assertive script may carry social, employment, family, or safety costs in unequal-power contexts.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: قبل استخدام جملة حازمة، افحص الأمان وعلاقة القوة واختر درجة الوضوح والتوقيت والقناة التي تناسب موقفك.

claims.claim: Generic communication or conflict-resolution exercises are not an adequate response to coercion or intimate-partner violence; survivor-centered safety takes priority.
claims.evidence_type: meta-analysis and WHO clinical guidance
claims.population: Relationship-education participants and women subjected to partner or sexual violence
claims.cultural_context: Global guidance requiring locally verified survivor services
claims.limitations: Motazen cannot privately assess violence or safely individualize a plan; device monitoring and disclosure can create risk.
claims.counterevidence: The randomized relationship-education estimate for aggression was not significant, despite larger pre-post associations.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: إذا وُجد تهديد أو عنف أو تحكم قهري، فالأولوية للأمان والدعم المتخصص؛ لا يلزمك الدخول في مواجهة أو جلسة تواصل قد تزيد الخطر.

claims.claim: Some structured forgiveness interventions improve average wellbeing outcomes, but forgiveness is not equivalent to reconciliation, renewed contact, trust, or waiving accountability.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review with meta-analysis plus safety guidance
claims.population: People after varied interpersonal hurts or violence
claims.cultural_context: Multi-country clinical evidence with culturally variable meanings of forgiveness and duty
claims.limitations: Interventions are structured processes, not pressure to forgive; safety, justice, distance, and non-reconciliation remain valid choices.
claims.counterevidence: No wellbeing estimate establishes that contact with the person who caused harm is safe or beneficial.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: التسامح—إن اخترته—لا يعني المصالحة أو استعادة الثقة أو التواصل أو إسقاط المسؤولية، ويمكن أن يبقى الأمان والمسافة أولويتك.

claims.claim: Digital-detox interventions do not show uniform mental-health benefits, so total abstinence or a universal screen-time threshold should not be prescribed as a cure.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.population: Participants in ten heterogeneous digital-detox studies
claims.cultural_context: Multi-country evidence without Egyptian usage-pattern validation
claims.limitations: Definitions and interventions varied and there were no significant average effects for life satisfaction, stress, or overall wellbeing.
claims.counterevidence: A small depressive-symptom effect coexisted with null results on other outcomes.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: التوازن الرقمي ليس انقطاعًا كاملًا بالضرورة؛ جرّب تعديلًا محددًا يخدم نومك أو تركيزك أو علاقتك وقيّم أثره عليك.

claims.claim: Misinformation inoculation can modestly improve discernment, but it does not reliably change sharing intention and some components work only in combination.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review with meta-analysis and multi-study counterevidence
claims.population: Online participants in misinformation studies
claims.cultural_context: Predominantly non-Arab experimental materials; Arabic media transfer untested
claims.limitations: Credibility tasks and intentions are not equivalent to durable behavior; sponsor and employment conflicts were disclosed in one key study.
claims.counterevidence: Inoculation alone did not improve truth discernment in five real-headline experiments, while combination with an accuracy prompt did.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: قبل التصديق أو المشاركة، توقّف واسأل: من المصدر؟ ما الدليل؟ وهل أستطيع التحقق من جهة مستقلة؟ معرفة حيلة التلاعب وحدها لا تكفي دائمًا.

claims.claim: Generative AI can produce plausible but inaccurate, biased, or incomplete health information and must not be treated as a clinician, crisis service, or authoritative source.
claims.evidence_type: WHO ethics and governance guidance
claims.population: People and systems affected by generative AI for health
claims.cultural_context: Global governance guidance without Arabic or Egyptian model validation
claims.limitations: The guidance does not rate a particular model or guarantee that disclosure, warnings, or filters eliminate risk.
claims.counterevidence: Potential access and education benefits exist, but require defined use, evaluation, human accountability, and privacy safeguards.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: قد تبدو إجابة الذكاء الاصطناعي واثقة وهي خاطئة؛ لا تشارك بيانات حساسة وتحقق من المعلومات الصحية ولا تعتمد عليه كطبيب أو خدمة طوارئ.

claims.claim: Financial education and capability programs do not have strong uniform evidence for improving financial behavior or outcomes, and structural constraints cannot be reframed as personal failure.
claims.evidence_type: Campbell systematic review
claims.population: Participants in 24 unique OECD-country intervention studies
claims.cultural_context: OECD evidence without Egyptian inflation, income, banking, debt, or informal-economy validation
claims.limitations: Interventions and outcomes were too heterogeneous for pooling and many studies had methodological weaknesses.
claims.counterevidence: Some interventions may help selected behaviors, but education cannot by itself change income, prices, debt terms, or product access.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: تنظيم المال قد يساعد في رؤية الخيارات، لكنه لا يصنع دخلًا ولا يلغي الغلاء أو الديون؛ لا تحوّل قيدًا اقتصاديًا إلى لوم شخصي.

claims.claim: Work exhaustion is shaped by organizational conditions, and individual coping practices must not substitute for action on workload, schedule, control, support, or safety.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.population: Active workers in organizational intervention studies
claims.cultural_context: Multi-country evidence with no direct Egyptian labor-sector validation
claims.limitations: The pooled reduction was small and evidence certainty very low because of heterogeneity, bias risk, and few studies.
claims.counterevidence: An individual relaxation exercise may provide short-term relief without changing the condition producing exhaustion.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: الإجهاد في العمل ليس دائمًا مشكلة مهارة شخصية؛ افصل ما يمكنك تعديله عن عبء أو نظام يحتاج دعمًا أو تفاوضًا أو تغييرًا تنظيميًا.

claims.claim: Meaning-in-life interventions show heterogeneous effects and do not support prescribing one universal purpose, career, moral hierarchy, or spiritual interpretation.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials
claims.population: Participants in 33 randomized controlled trials
claims.cultural_context: Culturally varied meanings not resolved by pooled English-language evidence
claims.limitations: Effects were much larger against passive than active controls and constructs and interventions varied.
claims.counterevidence: A person may hold multiple changing sources of meaning, and uncertainty about purpose is not pathology.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: المعنى ليس إجابة واحدة نهائية؛ يمكن أن يتكوّن من قيم وعلاقات وعمل ورعاية وإيمان أو تعلّم، ويتغير مع مراحل الحياة.

claims.claim: Volunteering may be associated with wellbeing benefits, but evidence quality and selection limits do not justify prescribing unpaid service as a wellbeing obligation.
claims.evidence_type: umbrella review
claims.population: Review populations dominated by older adults in the United States
claims.cultural_context: Volunteer roles and unpaid obligations vary by class, gender, age, community, and culture
claims.limitations: Healthy-volunteer selection, role quality, access, motives, and unpaid burden complicate causal inference.
claims.counterevidence: Community contribution can drain time, money, safety, or care capacity and may be exploitative rather than beneficial.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: المساهمة المجتمعية اختيار وليست واجبًا للعافية؛ اختر دورًا آمنًا ومتبادلًا يناسب وقتك وطاقتك ولا يستغلك.

claims.claim: Technical accessibility conformance is a baseline, not proof of cognitive usability or comprehension; direct participation by disabled users remains required.
claims.evidence_type: technical standard, supplemental guidance, and rapid evidence assessment
claims.population: People with diverse disabilities including cognitive and learning disabilities
claims.cultural_context: Global guidance not yet validated with Arabic-speaking Egyptian Motazen users
claims.limitations: Automated checks cannot establish comprehension, fatigue tolerance, assistive-technology compatibility, or right-to-left interaction quality.
claims.counterevidence: A page can meet selected WCAG criteria and still be confusing, exhausting, or inaccessible in practice.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: يجب أن تكون الخطوة قصيرة وواضحة ويمكن تخطيها أو سماعها أو العودة إليها؛ صعوبة الواجهة ليست فشلًا من المستخدم.

claims.claim: Low-stakes retrieval and distributed review can improve later retention, but neither guarantees transfer to a new situation or real-world behavior.
claims.evidence_type: systematic reviews and meta-analyses of retrieval, transfer, and distributed classroom practice
claims.population: Learners across classroom and experimental settings
claims.cultural_context: Predominantly WEIRD educational evidence with little non-WEIRD representation
claims.limitations: Effects depend on timing, task design, feedback, initial success, and transfer target; the studies do not validate Motazen's final sequence or Arabic delivery.
claims.counterevidence: Bias-adjusted transfer estimates can shrink substantially when favorable moderators are absent, and recalled knowledge may still fail to change behavior.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: استرجاع الفكرة من الذاكرة والعودة إليها على فترات قد يساعدانك على تذكرها؛ لكن التذكر لا يضمن أنك ستطبقها في موقف حقيقي، لذلك نضيف ممارسة ومراجعة دون درجات أو إحراج.

claims.claim: Bite-sized content can support knowledge outcomes, but evidence does not justify a universal microlearning dose and does not show reliable behavior change by itself.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review of controlled microlearning studies
claims.population: People of varied ages in self-care microlearning studies
claims.cultural_context: Heterogeneous international evidence with no Egyptian Arabic curriculum trial
claims.limitations: Most included studies had moderate-to-high risk of bias, and only a minority of studies measuring behavior reported significant improvement.
claims.counterevidence: Short content may be easier to consume while remaining insufficient for application, environmental change, or durable behavior.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: الدرس القصير قد يسهّل الفهم، لكنه ليس جرعة سحرية ولا يغيّر السلوك وحده؛ اختر الحد الأدنى عند الإرهاق ثم جرّب خطوة واقعية عندما تستطيع.

claims.claim: Attrition and declining use are common in digital intervention research and should be treated as product, context, and measurement signals rather than user moral failure.
claims.evidence_type: systematic and meta-analytic reviews of digital intervention attrition and culturally adapted engagement
claims.population: Adults in smartphone and culturally adapted digital mental-health intervention trials
claims.cultural_context: Multi-country clinical-intervention evidence; culturally adapted review focused on non-WEIRD settings
claims.limitations: Motazen is educational rather than treatment, definitions vary, and associations between adaptation depth and retention do not prove causation.
claims.counterevidence: Reminder and compensation associations in trials do not justify shame, loss aversion, compulsive streaks, or assuming more engagement causes better outcomes.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: لو توقفت أو فاتتك أيام، فهذا لا يثبت ضعفك؛ قد يكون الوقت أو الطاقة أو الخصوصية أو صعوبة الدرس هي المشكلة، ونراجع الحاجز بدل تصفير تقدمك.

claims.claim: A nonjudgmental explain-it-back check can reveal misunderstanding, but a self-guided product cannot claim equivalence to clinician-delivered teach-back.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review of teach-back implementation plus cognitive accessibility guidance
claims.population: Patients in healthcare communication studies and people with cognitive or learning disabilities
claims.cultural_context: Clinical and global accessibility evidence not yet tested in Egyptian Arabic self-guided learning
claims.limitations: A static comprehension question cannot observe tone, correct a misconception reliably, or replace a trained human conversation.
claims.counterevidence: Poorly phrased recall checks may feel like tests, increase shame, or measure memory rather than understanding.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: جرّب شرح الفكرة بكلماتك لنفسك؛ لو لم تستطع فالمحتوى يحتاج تبسيطًا أو مثالًا آخر، وليس معنى ذلك أنك فشلت.

claims.claim: More precise emotion labeling is associated with some regulatory and behavioral benefits, but effects are small or task-dependent and teaching labels has not been shown to universally improve wellbeing.
claims.evidence_type: narrative review of affect labeling and meta-analysis of emotion differentiation associations
claims.population: Clinical and nonclinical participants in predominantly non-Arab research
claims.cultural_context: Emotion categories and ordinary expressions are language- and culture-sensitive; Egyptian Arabic validation is absent
claims.limitations: Labeling effects differ by timing, task, target, and label generation; differentiation evidence is correlational and heterogeneous.
claims.counterevidence: Self-generated labels may temporarily increase affect, affect labeling did not reduce shame in one cited experiment, and no evidence supports a perfect universal emotion wheel.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: تسمية شعورك بدقة قد تساعدك على اختيار خطوة أنسب، لكنها لا تُلزمك بكلمة واحدة ولا تضمن أن يهدأ الشعور فورًا؛ يمكنك قول «مش متأكد» ووصف ما تلاحظه.

claims.claim: Repetitive negative thinking is not equivalent to all reflection, and persistent rumination or worry should not be reduced to a broad willpower or attention-control defect.
claims.evidence_type: meta-analyses of mechanisms and psychological interventions
claims.population: Clinical and nonclinical participants across heterogeneous studies
claims.cultural_context: International evidence without direct Egyptian adult mechanism or intervention validation
claims.limitations: Associations are small and specific, and intervention benefits were larger with professional delivery; Motazen cannot provide treatment.
claims.counterevidence: The meta-analysis found no broad deficit across most cognitive-control functions, and reduced rumination produced smaller behavior than cognitive effects.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: التأمل قد ينتهي بفهم أو قرار، أما الدوران المتكرر حول نفس الألم بلا خطوة فقد يستنزفك؛ هذا ليس دليل ضعف إرادة، وإذا طال أو عطّل حياتك فقد يفيد دعم مهني.

claims.claim: Acute stress and sleep loss can alter decision processes, but effects are generally context-dependent and do not make every stressed or tired decision uniformly poor.
claims.evidence_type: meta-analysis and systematic reviews of stress, sleep deprivation, and decisional needs
claims.population: Healthy adults in laboratory studies and people making health or social decisions
claims.cultural_context: Predominantly non-Egyptian laboratory and healthcare evidence
claims.limitations: Average effects are small or mixed and vary by task, timing, framing, stressor, and individual conditions.
claims.counterevidence: Some decision tasks show no significant effect or more conservative rather than riskier behavior under sleep loss or stress.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: لو القرار مهم وأنت تحت ضغط شديد أو محروم من النوم، أجّل غير العاجل إن أمكن أو بسّط الخيارات واطلب رأيًا موثوقًا؛ التعب لا يعني أن كل قرار ستتخذه خطأ.

claims.claim: Choice overload is not a universal law, so ordinary indecision or analysis paralysis should not be explained simply by having too many options.
claims.evidence_type: meta-analysis of choice overload and mixed-studies decision-needs review
claims.population: Participants in consumer experiments and people making health or social decisions
claims.cultural_context: No direct Egyptian everyday-decision validation
claims.limitations: A near-zero mean conceals contextual variation; decision difficulty can also arise from stakes, information quality, power, values conflict, timing, or missing support.
claims.counterevidence: Some specific contexts do show overload, so simplifying options is a reversible experiment rather than a universal cure.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: كثرة البدائل قد تربك بعض الناس في بعض المواقف، لكنها ليست السبب دائمًا؛ حدّد القرار والموعد والمعلومات الناقصة والقيم المهمة قبل أن تختصر الخيارات.

claims.claim: A professional consensus recommends at least seven hours of regular sleep for healthy adults aged 18 to 60, but this population guidance is not a diagnosis, individual quota, or complete definition of healthy sleep.
claims.evidence_type: professional consensus statement and government health guidance
claims.population: Healthy adults aged 18 to 60 with separate contextual guidance for shift workers
claims.cultural_context: US-led guidance requiring adaptation to Egyptian schedules, housing, caregiving, work, health, and climate
claims.limitations: Duration alone omits timing, continuity, quality, disorders, medications, pain, caregiving, and individual need.
claims.counterevidence: The consensus itself reports uncertainty around some duration ranges and does not establish that every adult has the same optimal amount.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: التوصية العامة لمعظم البالغين هي إتاحة سبع ساعات أو أكثر بانتظام، لكنها ليست حكمًا على شخصك؛ الجودة والتوقيت والعمل والرعاية والصحة قد تغيّر ما تحتاج إلى مناقشته مع مختص.

claims.claim: Caffeine timing and screen use are relevant sleep factors, but universal bans and exact cutoffs should be replaced by low-risk contextual experiments and medical escalation when problems persist or impair function.
claims.evidence_type: systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and government guidance
claims.population: General adults and mixed-age cohorts across experimental and observational evidence
claims.cultural_context: International evidence without a direct Egyptian adult intervention trial
claims.limitations: Screen evidence is largely observational; caffeine response varies; generic sleep hygiene is not equivalent to insomnia treatment.
claims.counterevidence: Not every screen exposure or late caffeine use produces the same outcome, and persistent sleep problems can reflect medical, psychiatric, medication, pain, breathing, or work-schedule factors.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: بدل منع مطلق، غيّر عاملًا واحدًا لأيام قليلة—مثل توقيت الكافيين أو استخدام الشاشة قبل النوم—وسجّل ما يحدث؛ إذا استمرت المشكلة أو عطلت نهارك فالتقييم المهني أهم من لوم الانضباط.

claims.claim: Motivation can be supported by autonomy, competence, relatedness, and a supportive context, but average behavior effects are small and motivation should not be treated as a fixed trait, moral virtue, or mandatory feeling before action.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and meta-analyses of controlled and randomized health-behavior interventions
claims.population: Children and adults across multiple health behaviors in predominantly non-Arab settings
claims.cultural_context: No direct validation of a self-guided Egyptian motivation curriculum
claims.limitations: Interventions and behaviors were heterogeneous, techniques operated in combinations, and individual strategy effects were limited.
claims.counterevidence: A person may act without first feeling motivated, and a supportive technique may change perceived motivation without producing durable behavior change.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: الدافع مش صفة ثابتة ولا مقياس لقيمتك. جرّب خطوة صغيرة تختارها أنت، واجعل النجاح فيها واضحًا وممكنًا؛ لو لم تشعر بالحماس قبلها فهذا لا يعني أنك كسول أو فاشل.

claims.claim: Ordinary distraction, fatigue, stress, sleep loss, interruptions, or task mismatch are not by themselves evidence of ADHD; persistent developmental symptoms with meaningful impairment across settings require specialist assessment and differential diagnosis.
claims.evidence_type: evidence-based clinical guideline
claims.population: Adults and younger people with possible ADHD
claims.cultural_context: UK diagnostic guidance; Egyptian professional pathways and Arabic terminology require local review
claims.limitations: Motazen cannot assess developmental history, rule out other causes, observe multiple settings, or determine clinical impairment.
claims.counterevidence: A short quiz, a difficult week, heavy phone use, procrastination, or identifying with online symptom content cannot establish or exclude ADHD.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: التشتت العابر له أسباب كثيرة ولا يساوي تشخيص فرط حركة وتشتت انتباه. لو الأعراض بدأت من الصغر، مستمرة، وتؤثر بوضوح في أكثر من جانب من حياتك، فالتقييم عند مختص مدرّب أهم من أي اختبار ذاتي.

claims.claim: Digital interruptions and media multitasking can be tested as contextual contributors to distraction, but neither smartphone presence nor a single blocking tool has a universal, well-established cognitive effect.
claims.evidence_type: systematic reviews and meta-analyses of smartphone presence and digital self-control tools
claims.population: Mostly laboratory participants and learners in predominantly non-Egyptian studies
claims.cultural_context: Device access can be essential for Egyptian work, caregiving, transport, finance, and safety, so blanket removal may be infeasible
claims.limitations: Active notifications, checking, content, task demands, and real-world obligations differ from mere phone presence; intervention evidence is sparse and heterogeneous.
claims.counterevidence: Most pooled cognitive outcomes for mere smartphone presence were null, and visualization or blocking tools did not work consistently.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: لو الهاتف يقطع تركيزك، اختبر تغييرًا واحدًا قابلًا للرجوع—مثل كتم تنبيهات غير ضرورية أثناء مهمة قصيرة—وقارن النتيجة. وجود الهاتف وحده ليس سببًا ثابتًا، والمنع الكامل مش مناسب لكل الناس أو الأعمال.

claims.claim: Online social comparison and envy can coincide with lower wellbeing, but effects are heterogeneous, conditional, and sometimes reciprocal or positive, so total screen time or passive use is not a sufficient personal explanation.
claims.evidence_type: critical review and umbrella review of overlapping social-media evidence
claims.population: Social-media users across heterogeneous international samples
claims.cultural_context: Comparison targets, public presentation, family expectations, class, gender, and platform norms require Egyptian contextual testing
claims.limitations: Observational self-report and reverse causation are common, and active-versus-passive categories are too coarse for individual guidance.
claims.counterevidence: Some users and contexts show neutral or positive effects, including inspiration, information, identity, connection, and social support.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: لو المقارنة على منصة معينة بتضغط عليك، راقب مين أو إيه بيشغّلها وجرّب تعديلًا صغيرًا في المتابعة أو التوقيت. المشكلة مش بالضرورة عدد الدقائق، ومش كل مقارنة مؤذية لكل شخص.

claims.claim: Anger is not inherently bad, but rumination, suppression, avoidance, and high-arousal venting should not be sold as reliable relief; lower-arousal pauses can help on average while aggression or danger requires a safety response.
claims.evidence_type: meta-analyses of anger-regulation associations and arousal-changing activities
claims.population: Clinical and nonclinical participants across international studies
claims.cultural_context: Expression, suppression, power, safety, and acceptable exit options are culture-, gender-, family-, and workplace-sensitive
claims.limitations: Heterogeneity is large; pooled calming activities do not validate every method or address coercion, abuse, intoxication, weapons, or imminent violence.
claims.counterevidence: Exercise can have broad health value even though arousal-increasing activity was not an effective anger-reduction category, and some strategies may work differently by person and context.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: الغضب إشارة مش عيب، لكن تفريغه بالصوت أو الضرب مش طريقة مضمونة لتهدئته. ابعد مؤقتًا عن التصرف لو آمن، واختبر خطوة تهدّئ الاستثارة؛ لو فيه تهديد أو عنف فالأولوية للأمان وطلب مساعدة مناسبة.

claims.claim: Egyptian adults must not be treated as one uniform audience: direct national, household, clinic, and student evidence differs by age, sex, education, work, geography, health, sampling frame, and historical period.
claims.evidence_type: direct Egyptian representative, household, clinic, and university cross-sectional evidence
claims.population: Egyptian adults and adolescents across national, household, outpatient, and university samples
claims.cultural_context: Direct Egypt evidence with strong within-country differences and incomplete coverage of informal work, disability, remote areas, and current lived language
claims.date_range: Historical fieldwork through 2023 with sources published through 2025
claims.limitations: The sources measure different constructs and periods; none validates Motazen, provides current national mental-health literacy, or substitutes for participatory research.
claims.counterevidence: National averages can be useful for planning, but they do not establish a person's cause, capacity, resources, diagnosis, or preferred wording.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: المحتوى لازم يدي بدائل تناسب وقتك وشغلك وصحتك ومكانك ومسؤولياتك؛ مفيش تجربة مصرية واحدة تمثل كل الناس، والمتوسط العام مش حكم عليك.

claims.claim: Mindfulness and meditation are optional practices, not universally calming or harmless; users need an easy stop option, non-breath alternatives, and escalation when a practice triggers marked distress, dissociation, trauma re-experience, perceptual disturbance, or functional deterioration.
claims.evidence_type: systematic adverse-event review and systematic review of randomized-trial meta-analyses
claims.population: Adults across clinical, nonclinical, observational, experimental, and retreat settings
claims.cultural_context: Meditation, prayer, breathing, contemplation, and spiritual meanings differ; Motazen must not collapse religious practice into a clinical technique
claims.limitations: Adverse-event definitions and reporting are inconsistent, causal attribution is difficult, and risk estimates vary strongly by study design and exposure.
claims.counterevidence: Many people experience no harm and some benefit, but absence of systematic reporting cannot prove universal safety.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: تمارين التنفس أو التأمل اختيارية. لو زوّدت الخوف أو الدوخة أو الإحساس بالانفصال أو رجّعت ذكرى مؤلمة، أوقفها وانتقل لخطوة خارجية بسيطة وآمنة؛ استمرار الأثر أو تعطيله لحياتك يستحق مساعدة مختصة.

claims.claim: Spirituality, religion, family, community, and professional care can each support or hinder wellbeing depending on the person and context; Motazen must not frame faith and professional help as opposites or prescribe posttraumatic growth.
claims.evidence_type: direct Egyptian lived-experience qualitative study, narrow Egyptian clinical survey, and Arab systematic review
claims.population: Egyptian service users, Egyptian OCD patients, and heterogeneous Arab adult populations
claims.cultural_context: Direct and regional evidence showing varied roles for spirituality, family, stigma, trust, access, and professional services
claims.limitations: The Egyptian qualitative sample was small, the clinical survey was diagnosis-specific, and Arab evidence is heterogeneous.
claims.counterevidence: Spirituality was meaningful in some recovery accounts, while some religious illness interpretations accompanied delayed specialist contact in a narrow sample; neither pattern applies universally.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: ممكن قيمك أو إيمانك أو أهلك أو مختص يساعدوك بطرق مختلفة، ومش لازم تختار بينهم كأنهم خصوم. اختر دعمًا آمنًا يحترمك، ولا أحد مطالب أن يجد معنى أو نموًا في تجربة مؤلمة.

claims.claim: Adult identity should be framed as contextual, relational, and revisable rather than a single hidden true self that a short exercise can reveal; evidence linking specific identity processes to wellbeing remains limited and inconsistent.
claims.evidence_type: small systematic review and direct Egyptian lived-experience qualitative study
claims.population: International identity-study participants and 17 Egyptian adult service users
claims.cultural_context: Identity may include family, faith, work, community, health, and personal roles whose priority varies within Egypt
claims.limitations: The review included only 10 studies and the Egyptian qualitative sample was small and recovery-specific.
claims.counterevidence: Commitment may relate to development, but exploration findings and links to wellbeing are inconsistent; change does not imply inauthenticity.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: هويتك مش إجابة واحدة لازم تكتشفها مرة واحدة. ممكن تتكوّن من أدوارك وقيمك وعلاقاتك وتتغير مع الخبرة؛ اكتب وصفًا مؤقتًا يفيدك الآن واترك لنفسك حق مراجعته.

claims.claim: Adult friendship quality, supportive interaction, autonomy support, and maintenance are associated with wellbeing more consistently than a simplistic friend-count target, but causal and culturally transferable intervention evidence is weak.
claims.evidence_type: systematic reviews of adult friendship and connection constructs
claims.population: Adults across mostly non-Egyptian and student-weighted studies
claims.cultural_context: Friendship expectations, gender, public space, family integration, mobility, work, and digital contact require Egyptian study
claims.limitations: Cross-sectional designs dominate, dyadic and longitudinal work is limited, and wellbeing measures vary.
claims.counterevidence: More friends is not automatically better, close-friend labels were not consistently associated with wellbeing, and unsafe or one-sided ties should not be preserved for a metric.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: الصداقة مش سباق عدد. لو العلاقة آمنة ومهمة لك، جرّب فعل تواصل صغيرًا يحترم وقتكما واستقلالكما؛ ولو العلاقة مؤذية أو من طرف واحد فالحفاظ عليها مش واجب لمجرد اسم الصداقة.

claims.claim: Time management can support wellbeing and performance, but it should mean structuring, protecting, and adapting available time—not maximizing output or blaming people for time constrained by care, income, health, transport, or work control.
claims.evidence_type: meta-analysis plus structural work evidence and Egyptian-context constraint evidence
claims.population: Nonclinical international participants with contextual transfer to varied Egyptian adult samples
claims.cultural_context: Care work, informal work, commuting, service availability, household demands, disability, and income shape controllable time
claims.date_range: Evidence synthesized through 2021 with Egyptian contextual sources through 2025
claims.limitations: Most studies were cross-sectional, intervention content was opaque, and privilege confounds access to time-management practices.
claims.counterevidence: Productivity-focused time framing can increase pressure and inequality; some constraints require resources or collective change rather than a better planner.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: إدارة الوقت مش حشر مهام أكتر. حدّد الوقت المتاح فعلًا، احمِ جزءًا صغيرًا لما يهمك، وعدّل الخطة لما الظروف تتغير؛ ضغط الرعاية أو الشغل أو المواصلات مش فشل شخصي.

claims.claim: Civic and community engagement are optional, context-sensitive forms of participation with heterogeneous positive, negative, and null wellbeing associations; they must not become a moral score or expose users to unsafe action.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review and umbrella review of civic engagement and volunteering
claims.population: Young adults and predominantly older US volunteers across international reviews
claims.cultural_context: Egyptian legality, safety, power, access, political diversity, unpaid burden, and community forms require local expert review
claims.limitations: Causality, selection, activity type, duration, historical marginalization, and geographic transfer remain unresolved.
claims.counterevidence: Engagement can coexist with distress, burden, exclusion, retaliation risk, or no wellbeing change; nonparticipation is not a moral failure.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: المشاركة المجتمعية اختيار وليست اختبارًا لأخلاقك. إن أردت، اختر مساهمة صغيرة وآمنة ومناسبة لقدرتك وقوانين مكانك؛ الحماية والراحة أو عدم المشاركة لا تنقص من قيمتك.

claims.claim: Ethical reasoning can be practiced with concrete cases, consequences, stakeholders, uncertainty, and revision, but specialized ethics-training effects do not authorize Motazen to impose one ideology or equate correct quiz answers with ethical behavior.
claims.evidence_type: meta-analytic ethics-training review and systematic review of decision debiasing
claims.population: Predominantly academic, scientific, and professional learners in non-Egyptian settings
claims.cultural_context: Egyptian ethical language includes varied religious, legal, family, professional, civic, and personal frameworks that cannot be collapsed into one answer key
claims.limitations: Training outcomes often measure knowledge, judgments, or task decisions rather than durable behavior under real power and incentives.
claims.counterevidence: Effects vary by field, design, criterion, and practice; moral judgment and perception outcomes can be weaker than knowledge or narrow decision outcomes.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: في قرار أخلاقي صعب، حدّد من سيتأثر وما الضرر والحق أو الواجب وما الذي لا تعرفه، ثم راجع قرارك. التمرين لا يملك أن يفرض عليك عقيدة واحدة أو يمنحك درجة أخلاق.

claims.claim: Self-respect should be framed as stable human worth and dignified self-treatment rather than superiority, constant positive evaluation, or a requirement to feel confident; adult self-esteem interventions show modest average change but do not establish broad downstream benefit.
claims.evidence_type: systematic review/meta-analysis and narrative review with meta-analytic synthesis
claims.population: Adults in heterogeneous intervention and observational literatures, primarily outside Egypt
claims.cultural_context: Arabic and Egyptian meanings of dignity, respect, pride, humility, family standing, and religious worth require direct language testing
claims.limitations: Self-esteem measures are not identical to dignity or self-respect; interventions were heterogeneous and often targeted clinical or at-risk groups.
claims.counterevidence: Raising a self-rating does not prove better behavior or wellbeing, and inflated or contingent evaluation may create pressure, defensiveness, or comparison.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: احترامك لنفسك لا يحتاج أن تكون أفضل من غيرك ولا أن تشعر بالثقة طوال الوقت. عامِل نفسك بكرامة، وقيّم الفعل بصدق، من غير أن تختصر قيمتك في نجاح أو رأي الناس.

claims.claim: Useful responsibility language separates the next controllable action from causal blame, moral worth, and conditions outside the person's control; individual-responsibility framing can create shame, stigma, and victim blaming when structural forces are hidden.
claims.evidence_type: literature review of unintended message effects and public-health guidance on social determinants
claims.population: Health communication and public-health populations, mainly outside Egypt
claims.cultural_context: Economic constraint, unpaid care, gender, disability, family power, public services, and legal safety materially shape options in Egypt
claims.limitations: Health-disparity messaging is not a direct trial of general responsibility education, and no universal wording has been shown safe across contexts.
claims.counterevidence: Agency language may support action for some people, but it becomes inaccurate and harmful when it implies full control, equal opportunity, or deserved suffering.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: المسؤولية هنا ليست لومًا: فرّق بين ما حدث، وما لم يكن تحت سيطرتك، وما تستطيع فعله الآن. خطوة صغيرة أو طلب دعم قد يكونان مسؤولية؛ والظلم أو المرض أو ضيق الموارد ليس عيبًا فيك.

claims.claim: Errors can support learning when they are safe enough to examine and followed by feedback, correction, and another attempt, but generic growth-mindset messaging has little reliable effect on academic achievement and should not recast trauma, injustice, bereavement, or irreversible harm as useful failure.
claims.evidence_type: training meta-analysis, systematic review/meta-analysis counterevidence, and adverse-experience review
claims.population: Training participants and students, predominantly outside Egypt
claims.cultural_context: Egyptian work, education, family authority, financial stakes, and social shame can change whether disclosure and experimentation are safe
claims.limitations: Training tasks do not represent high-stakes failure, abuse, grief, moral injury, poverty, discrimination, or consequences without a retry.
claims.counterevidence: Higher-quality growth-mindset intervention evidence showed no reliable academic achievement effect, and forced positive reframing may invalidate harm or delay support.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: إن كان الخطأ آمنًا وقابلًا للتصحيح، اسأل: ماذا حدث، وما المعلومة الجديدة، وما المحاولة التالية؟ أما الفقد أو الظلم أو الأذى فليس درسًا واجبًا، ولا يلزمك أن تراه إيجابيًا.

claims.claim: Family can be a major source of support and care while caregiving can also carry substantial emotional, financial, and gendered burden; Motazen must not assume that family involvement is always available, safe, consensual, or cost-free.
claims.evidence_type: direct Egyptian cross-sectional study, Arab-region systematic review, and Egyptian qualitative lived-experience study
claims.population: Egyptian clinical caregivers and service users plus a small Arab-region clinical intervention literature
claims.cultural_context: Directly relevant to selected Egyptian and Arab clinical contexts but not representative of everyday family forms, regions, classes, ages, religions, or safety conditions
claims.limitations: Clinical and mostly cross-sectional samples cannot establish causality or define normal family duty, healthy hierarchy, privacy, consent, or universally safe communication.
claims.counterevidence: Family participation can support recovery and care, yet obligation, criticism, over-involvement, stigma, financial pressure, violence, or unequal labor can also harm; family absence is not personal failure.
claims.user_facing_wording_ar: الأسرة قد تكون سندًا، وقد تكون الرعاية مرهقة أو غير متاحة أو غير آمنة. حدّد من يساعد فعلًا وما الذي تستطيع تقديمه، واطلب توزيع الحمل أو دعمًا آخر حين يمكن؛ لا تُقاس محبتك بإلغاء نفسك.
